scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @cloudflare/playwright && npm run build --workspace @cloudflare/puppeteer && npm run build --workspace @cloudflare/playwright-mcp
scripts.build:puppeteer: npm run build --workspace @cloudflare/browser-test-runtime && npm run build --workspace @cloudflare/puppeteer
scripts.check:patches:puppeteer: npm run check:patch:playwright && npm run check:patch:puppeteer
scripts.check:patches: npm run check:patch:playwright && npm run check:patch:puppeteer && npm run check:patch:playwright-mcp
scripts.patch:playwright: cd submodules/playwright && git apply --reverse --check ../../patches/playwright.patch 2>/dev/null && echo 'playwright patch already applied' || git apply ../../patches/playwright.patch
scripts.patch:playwright-mcp: cd submodules/playwright-mcp && git apply --reverse --check ../../patches/playwright-mcp.patch 2>/dev/null && echo 'playwright-mcp patch already applied' || git apply ../../patches/playwright-mcp.patch
scripts.patch:puppeteer: cd submodules/puppeteer && git apply --reverse --check ../../patches/puppeteer.patch 2>/dev/null && echo 'puppeteer patch already applied' || git apply ../../patches/puppeteer.patch
scripts.diff: npm run diff:playwright && npm run diff:puppeteer && npm run diff:playwright-mcp
scripts.patch: npm run patch:playwright && npm run patch:puppeteer && npm run patch:playwright-mcp
